senses.gloss: (חָרַר II) to set free, emancipate. Y. Yeb. VIII, 8ᵃ top העושה עבדו … שִׁיחֲרָרוֹ מְשׁוֹחֲרָר if a man mortgages his slave and then sells him, he is not sold; if he sets him free, he is free.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:4">Gitt. IV, 4</cite> <he>עבד … ושחררו וכ׳</he> if a master mortgages his slave and sets him free …, we force the mortgagee to make him a freedman, but he (the slave) writes a note on his value; <cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:4">ib.</cite> <he>אינו כותב אלא מְשַׁחֲרָרוֹ</he> none but him who set him free has to write the note of indebtedness. Ib. 40ᵇ <he>מי שחררו</he> which of them (the mortgager or the mortgagee) set him free? <cite ref="Berakhot 47b:16">Ber. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ש׳ עבדו וכ׳</he> declared his slave free and made him serve to complete the number of ten persons (required for prayers).

<cite ref="Berakhot 47b:16">Ib.</cite>, a. e. <he>כל המְשַׁחֲרֵר עבדו וכ׳</he> whoever sets his slave free, violates a positive command; a. fr.—Part. pass. <he>מְשׁוֹחֲרָר</he>; f. <he>מְשׁוֹחֲרָרָה</he>, <he>מְשׁוֹחֲרֶרֶת</he> &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Gittin 4:4">Gitt. IV, 4</cite>; Y. Yeb. l. c., v. supra; a. fr.—Ib. VIII, 9ᶜ top (play on <he>שחרים</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 8:8">I Chr. VIII, 8</cite>) <he>זה בועז שהיה מש׳ מן וכ׳</he> that is Boaz who was free from sins; <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 3:7">Ruth R. to I, 21</cite> (Par. 4); (Yalk. Chr. 1077 <he>שנשתחרר</he>).

senses.gloss: to be set free. Yalk. l. c.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:1">Keth. III, 1</cite> <he>שנִשְׁתַּחֲרָרוּ</he> who were set free.
<cite ref="Gittin 43a:13-18">Gitt. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>חציה … ונִשְׁתַּחֲרָרָה</he> a woman that is half a slave and half free, who was betrothed to R., and then was set entirely free &c.; a. fr.
